**Status:** Modified | **Published:** 2018-04-03T16:29:00.237
**Severity:** HIGH (8

This is an etcd server (version 3.5) exposed on port 11379. It serves a /health endpoint returning health status and a /metrics endpoint exposing Prometheus metrics (auth revision, cluster version, etc). All other tested paths return 404 Not Found with CORS headers, so there is no web application—only the etcd API. Input to /health and /metrics is ignored; they are static endpoints.
